{{Quote|We once called this the Promised Land. It was a lie. It is our grave.|Lurr's recording about the fate of the [[Promised Ones]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Lurr''' was a [[Promised Ones|Promised One]] of the [[Outcasts (Taris)|Outcasts]] following [[Ku-ki]]'s leadership. She recorded at least one [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] about the fate of the Outcasts following their exodus to the [[Promised Land]], which was discovered by a Republic-identified individual on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Lurr had revealed that radiation had sterilized the remaining Outcasts, leaving them unable to [[Reproduction|procreate]] and thus dooming them to certain extinction. She lamented how they once called their home the Promised Land, but it instead would become their grave.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lurr was created for the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', appearing in the Taris general mission "Chasing History."<ref name="TOR" />
